questions.question: Does the license permit non-display algorithmic research, risk checks and trading use?
Which real-time, delayed and end-of-day feeds and target processes are entitled?
May raw and normalized data be stored, for how long, in which regions and with what access controls?
May encrypted backups and disaster-recovery replicas retain licensed data?
May features, labels, models, signals and aggregate reports be retained after source deletion?
Are local dashboards, exports, support access or redistribution permitted?
May data and lineage be retained for audit, incident and regulatory evidence?
How are revisions, corrections and deletions identified and replayed?
What export, deletion, certification and backup-expiry duties apply at termination?
What SLA, recovery, incident notice and historical replay commitments apply?
